title: Task card
description: A living card for one long operation that is not a pull request: a release or deploy, a migration, a diagnosis, a backup. Its steps, progress, findings and the one decision it may need. Show it once, then update it as each step completes.

subtitle.description: One line of context: target, environment, version, machine.

status.description: running: you are working. waiting: you need the user's decision (offer it in actions). done / failed / cancelled: finished.

status_text.description: One short line shown with a spinner or icon: what is happening right now.

steps.description: The plan, in order. Mark a step done or failed only after the tool result that proves it.

detail.description: Result in a few words: "12 passed", "42 s", "lock timeout".

metrics.description: Key figures from tool results: memory used, error rate, latency.

items.description: Findings, one row each: processes, hosts, files. Flag the culprit with tone bad.

log.description: The last few lines of output, newest last (five at most).

explanation.description: Why the agent needs a decision, or why it failed, in one or two sentences.

actions.description: Decisions offered to the user. Clicking one sends {action_id} back to the agent.

busy_label.description: What the pill says once clicked, e.g. "Deploying".
